params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: remove.bg's self-service API stops accepting requests on 1 December 2026 at 09:00 CET; the platform calls that API directly for every background removal, so cut-outs stop working that morning unless the integration moves to Leonardo.Ai (Canva) or another provider before then.

Source: Portal mail:16 (a forwarded remove.bg notice from the garage, asking whether anything has to be done for the move to Canva).

## What is wrong

`App\Http\Helpers\Photo::old_remove_background` posts multipart to `https://api.remove.bg/v1.0/removebg` with an `X-Api-Key` header (`size=preview`, `type=car`, `add_shadow=true`, optionally `bg_image_file`). `IntegrationChecks::checkRemovebg` reads the balance from `GET /v1.0/account` with the same key. remove.bg announces on its site and API page that background removal moves to Leonardo.Ai, also part of Canva, on 1 December 2026; the standalone website closes at 09:00 CET and the self-service API stops accepting requests the same day (enterprise contracts excepted). Our key is a self-service key, so from that moment every `ProcessImage` run fails at the remove.bg step: own-photo backgrounds and the platform copies of shared vehicles keep their original background, and the Koppelingen panel reports remove.bg as failed.

## What has to change

Leonardo.Ai publishes a migration guide (https://docs.leonardo.ai/docs/migrate-from-the-removebg-api-to-leonardoai). The relevant differences for us:

- Endpoint `POST https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v2/generationssync` (sync, one request returns the result), `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, JSON body with `model: "remove-bg"` and the options under `parameters`.
- `size=preview` and `type=car` keep their values. `add_shadow` has no equivalent (it is already deprecated on remove.bg); use `shadow_type` + `shadow_opacity`.
- `bg_image_file` is not supported: the dealer's background image has to be passed as `parameters.guidances.background_image_reference` (URL, base64 or an uploaded id). Base64 keeps the rule that a third party never calls back into the site (see the 2026-09-15 finding about remove.bg fetching the background from us).
- The response is JSON, not image bytes: read `results[0].dataB64` with `base64: true`, or download `results[0].url`. Set `ephemeral: true` so nothing persists in a Leonardo library.
- Errors can come back as HTTP 200 with an `errors[]` array; `RemoveBgRefusal` (the "no car in it" outcome, R S1-6.43) has to be mapped onto Leonardo's error codes.
- The balance check in `IntegrationChecks` and the environment line on the Koppelingen panel read remove.bg credits; Leonardo bills in USD per image (the guide states USD 0.1047 per image) and returns a `cost` object per call, so "saldo" needs a new source or disappears.
- `RemoveBgKey` (the encrypted per-dealer `api_key` setting with the `REMOVEBG_API_KEY` fallback), the `removebg` outbound seal and the smoke test all name remove.bg; decide whether they are renamed or kept as the generic "background removal" key.

## Open decisions before building

1. Leonardo.Ai or another provider. Leonardo is the path remove.bg points to and keeps the parameters, but it is per-image USD pricing without a preview discount as far as the guide says; the current cost is 0.25 credit per preview call.
2. Who opens the Leonardo.Ai account and holds the API key (today the remove.bg account is the garage's).
3. Whether to keep a remove.bg fallback until 1 December or switch in one go once the new key is in the settings.

Related: #990 (one own photo gets two platform copies, which doubles the spend per photo), #584 (the key is a platform setting).
params.title: Move background removal off the remove.bg API before it stops on 1 December 2026
